rationale: dual_domain_n2i-claude-agentic: train_n=200, val_n=24, batch_size=1, grad_clip=0.3, seed=42, warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=6, n_iter=75, outer_wall_s=1700, lr=0.0001, unet_c=16, rationale=iter-20 (FINAL): ONE knob -> n_iter 150 -> 75 (HALVE per-scan Adam steps once more), at the iter-19 recorded config on the val_n=24 basis (val_n=24/ep6/lr1e-4/warm_start=True/unet_c16/seed42/grad_clip0.3). DIAGNOSIS (numbers, not pixels): the per-scan n_iter-down sweep has been MONOTONICALLY IMPROVING: iter-17 n_iter600 0.45784 (hr 0.0005) -> iter-18 n_iter300 0.49506 (hr 0.03613) -> iter-19 n_iter150 0.51694 (hr 0.09101, PSNR 14.271), the RUN-BEST, finally beating the old iter-5 val_n=6 peak 0.50811 and clearing the noise floor. Headroom climbed 0.0005 -> 0.0361 -> 0.0910 in lockstep. CONFIRMS the campaign-state insight that fewer per-scan steps reduce per-image U-Net overfit (raising n_iter HURTS: demo 0.4785->0.4293 @n_iter1200); fewer steps keep each per-scan fit nearer the good warm-start init (less single-scan U-Net overfit). FAILURE MODE being cured = the 0.466 M-param U-Net OVERFITS each single noisy 128-view sparse-phantom scan in the no-early-stop _fit_one_scene loop. LEVER CHOICE (box-3, exactly ONE knob): continue the confirmed n_iter-down trend 150->75 -- the clean FINAL test of whether the monotone improvement continues toward a smaller-n_iter optimum, or plateaus/reverses as the fit becomes under-resolved (too few steps to refine off the warm-start init). This is the decisive last datapoint on the n_iter axis for the iter-20 writeup. KEPT FIXED (settled, do NOT touch): warm_start=True (LOAD-BEARING-POSITIVE, iter-8 off -0.0595), lr=1e-4 (iter-3/iter-9 bracket as per-scan optimum), val_n=24 (stable comparison basis, same as iter-13..19), grad_clip=0.3, unet_c=16, seed=42 (peak basin), pretrain_epochs=6 (budget-fit init, same as iter-18/19). HYPOTHESIS: n_iter=75 lifts the val_n=24 seed42 mean above iter-19 0.51694 (trend continues toward a smaller-n_iter optimum) OR plateaus/dips (n_iter has an optimum near 100-150 and 75 is under-resolved). FALSIFIER: delta vs 0.51694 < +0.005 or negative => n_iter optimum is near 150 and the warm-start init quality is the binding ceiling; either branch is the decisive final n_iter-axis datapoint. WALL: iter-19 ran warm6x200=1200 + per-image 24x150=3600 = 4800 steps in 402.7 s (~0.084 s/step). New budget = warm 1200 + per-image 24x75=1800 = 3000 steps ~= 252 s (~4.2 min), and even on a slow node (~0.11 s/step) ~330 s (~5.5 min) -- well under the 15-min target, the outer_wall_s=1700 guard, and the 00:30:00 (1800 s) sbatch wall. All recon-affecting knobs IDENTICAL to the iter-19 recorded config EXCEPT n_iter 150->75.
